en-GB.title: Trial Guardian
en-GB.subtitle: Cancel free trials in time
en-GB.promoText: Share a sign-up email or screenshot and Trial Guardian reminds you before the first charge, with a Lock Screen countdown. No account, no inbox access, no subscription.
en-GB.description:
Free trials are easy to start and easy to forget. Trial Guardian makes sure you decide before you pay.

SHARE IT, DONE
When you start a free trial, share the sign-up email or a screenshot of the offer to Trial Guardian. It reads the service, the price and the day you'll be charged, right on your iPhone. Share a screenshot of your Apple Subscriptions screen to add them all at once.

REMINDERS THAT ARRIVE IN TIME
Get a nudge a few days before, on the last day, and on the last evening. Turn on daily reminders for the final week if you can't afford to miss one. Answer straight from the notification: I cancelled it, Keep it, or Remind me tonight. App Store trials are handled a day early, because Apple needs 24 hours' notice.

KNOW HOW TO CANCEL
Step-by-step cancel guides for popular services, a one-tap cancel link, and a tip when you can cancel now and keep using the trial until it ends.

PROOF AND PEACE OF MIND
Attach a screenshot of the cancellation. The day after the charge date, Trial Guardian checks in so you can make sure no payment slipped through, with refund help if one did.

A COUNTDOWN ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
In the final hours a Live Activity counts down on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. The widget shows the next trial to cancel, and you can tick it off right from the Home Screen.

SUBSCRIPTIONS YOU KEEP
Decided to pay? Trial Guardian tracks it as a subscription, shows your monthly and yearly total, reminds you before each renewal and warns you when a price goes up.

WORKS WITH YOUR IPHONE
- Siri and Shortcuts: "Which trials end soon in Trial Guardian?"
- Add the last day to cancel to your Calendar.
- Optional iCloud sync between your devices, plus CSV export and backups.
- Face ID lock.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Everything is read on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded.
- No account and no sign-in.
- No access to your email or bank.
- Your trials stay on your device, or in your own iCloud if you turn on sync.

PAY ONCE
Trial Guardian is a one-time purchase. No subscription, which seems only fair for an app that helps you avoid them.

review.notes: No account is needed. To test, open the app, tap Add a trial, choose Type it in, and save a trial with a charge date tomorrow. Reminders and the Lock Screen countdown use local notifications and Live Activities only. You can also share any free trial email text to the app from Mail or Notes.
